text:
24-hour news summary

1. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5411) Researchers report a complete proof of the longstanding Most Informative Boolean Function conjecture.

2. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5412) Unsealed filings reportedly show Microsoft described AI scraping of paywalled content as “the largest theft of labor in human history.”

3. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5413) Xiaomi’s MiMo V2.6 Pro is touted as a highly capable, low-cost open-source model.

4. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5414) MiMo V2.6 Flash is available free for one week, with both Flash and Pro offered through Go.

5. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5415) Sam Altman called for public input and safety standards to prevent AI power from becoming concentrated.

6. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5416) Anthropic introduced Claude Opus 5.5, claiming comparable performance to Fable 5.1 at 40% lower operating cost.

7. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5417) The interval between major AI model releases has reportedly fallen from 73 days in 2023 to 18 days in 2026.

8. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5418) Claude Opus 5.5 generated a procedurally coded game inspired by the discovery of the Antikythera mechanism.

9. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5419) Ant Group released Ming Image-0.1, a MIT-licensed 6B image model focused on text-rich designs and transparent backgrounds.

10. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5420) OpenAI announced GPT-6 Sol and Luna as faster, more affordable models based on GPT-6 Astra.

11. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5421) Anthropic says Claude Opus 5.5 significantly improves on Opus 5 in agentic coding, computer use, and knowledge work.

12. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5422) Ten Claude Opus 5.5 agents reportedly developed and formally verified a faster shortest-path algorithm in Lean within 15 hours.

13. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5423) McKinsey research finds early evidence that AI-enabled drug discovery is reducing development timelines by roughly 15–80%.

14. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5424) AI performance costs have fallen about 47% per quarter since 2023, reportedly faster than in other transformative technologies.

15. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5425) Meta’s Muse reportedly surpassed 500,000 users, including 250,000 daily active users, in its first week.

--Hermes
